validation.maxLessThanMin: Max click delay must be greater than or equal to min click delay.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.soundAlerts: Play a sound on incoming attacks
appearance.soundAlertsHint: Plays a short beep in the browser when a new incoming attack is detected while the app is open. Your browser may ask for permission to play sound on first use.

humanization.title: Humanization
humanization.hint: The bot inserts a uniform-random pause from this range before every browser click, keypress, and navigation. Fixed delays are the single easiest bot-detection signal — keep a range, don't collapse it to one value unless you're sure.
humanization.clickDelayHint: Both bounds must be 1–{{max}} ms and max ≥ min.
humanization.rateLimitHint: Hard cap on browser actions per minute per account. The click delay spaces individual actions; this caps the sustained rate so a burst of scheduled work can't fire many requests in a few seconds. A short burst up to this value is allowed after idle time.

scraping.title: Scraping
scraping.hint: Controls how often the background scheduler refreshes data from the game. Shorter intervals mean fresher data but more network activity — pick values you'd be comfortable explaining to a human observer.
scraping.defaultCheckHint: Fallback applied to accounts that don't have their own per-account interval configured.
scraping.villageScrapingEnabledHint: Global kill-switch. Turn off to silence every scheduled village scrape, no matter what each village's own setting says. Manual scrapes (Scan now, Scrape current/all) still work.
scraping.autoReloginHint: When a scheduled scrape finds the browser session gone, log back in automatically (at most one attempt per account every 10 minutes) and continue. Off by default — an unattended login can run into a captcha loop. Respects each account's active-hours window.

map.title: World map
map.subtitle: Every settled village from the daily map.sql — pan, zoom, hover for details.
map.pickServer: Pick a Travian server above to load its world map.
map.empty: No map data yet for this server. Hit "Sync map data" to pull the latest map.sql.

telegram.subtitle: Push alerts to a Telegram chat via a bot.

connection.title: Connection
connection.hint: Create a bot with @BotFather to get a token, then message it (or add it to a group) so it can post. Everything below stays disabled until both fields are set.
connection.enabledHint: Master switch. Off suppresses every Telegram post regardless of the per-event toggles.
connection.botTokenHint: From @BotFather, looks like 123456789:ABCdef… Treat it as secret — anyone with it can post as your bot.
connection.chatIdHint: Numeric user/group id, or @channelname for a channel. Use @userinfobot to find your numeric id.

test.tooltip: Post a quick test message to the saved chat. Bypasses the master switch.
test.disabledNoConfig: Set the bot token and chat id first.

discord.pageSubtitle: Post bot alerts to a Discord channel via webhook. Create a webhook in the channel's Integrations panel, paste its URL below, and pick which events should ping you.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.hint: The single connection point between the bot and your Discord channel. Everything below is dimmed until a URL is set.
webhook.enabledHint: Master switch. Off means no posts even if individual triggers are enabled.
webhook.urlHint: Anyone with this URL can post to the channel — treat it like a password.

test.tooltip: Post a quick test message to the saved webhook. Bypasses the master switch.

identity.title: Bot identity
identity.hint: How the bot identifies itself in Discord. Both fields are optional — Discord shows the default webhook name/avatar if you leave them blank.
identity.avatarHint: Square PNG/JPG works best (Discord rescales to 128×128).

mentions.title: Mentions
mentions.hint: Optionally prepend a Discord @-mention to every alert so it actually pings someone instead of silently posting.
mentions.format: Use the literal Discord mention format. Right-click a user/role in Developer Mode → Copy Mention; paste verbatim.

triggers.title: Notification triggers
triggers.hint: Pick which events should generate a Discord post. Mute the chatty ones, keep the critical ones.
triggers.incomingAttackHint: A red-flag attack just got recorded (paste-in or scrape).
triggers.incomingRaidHint: A yellow-flag raid landed in the incoming list.
triggers.returnCatchHint: Planner spotted a launchable snipe window on an attacker.
triggers.captchaHint: Browser session hit a captcha challenge and needs you to solve it.
triggers.sessionLostHint: An account's browser session got logged out unexpectedly.
triggers.resourceOverflowHint: A village's warehouse or granary crossed ~95% of capacity — resources are about to be wasted.

statistics.subtitle: Weekly top-10 rankings for this server. One capture every hour while this page is open; use the tabs below to switch between PvP, PvE, Defense and Raiders.
statistics.pickAccount: Pick an account on the Accounts page to see statistics.
statistics.chartEmpty: Not enough data yet — waiting for at least two captures.

pvp.empty: No data yet. Make sure the account is logged in, then click Capture now.
